decisions.reason: The startup accelerator lies outside the firm's machinery and recycling engineering knowledge base, so the firm has little related knowledge to interpret its results or improve it, and a growing core business is likely to pull its resources back.

The bio-based bitumen binder draws on the firm's own R&D in waste-to-material conversion and is presented as a flagship, so despite its distance from plant building the firm will likely keep developing it for another year.
The infectious waste plant builds on the modular WASTX platform and is co-developed with ERMAFA, which gives the firm strong absorptive capacity to learn from early results and refine it.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant is a close extension of the core decentralized recycling machinery and also serves as a pretreatment stage, so customer feedback is easy to assimilate and apply.
